entries.description: Operator set pathAwareCritique: advisory.
Registered session 1 via start_session (copilot / claude-opus-5 / high); read the preload, the 2026-08-04 proposal doc SS2-SS11, and Set 110 operator-notes (2026-08-05 sections).

Enforced the bounded totals in verify_session: evaluate_phase_bound + count_phase_family_rounds refuse a 3rd discovery-family pass, 3rd remediation-review cycle, or 3rd classic round before any metered call, unless --operator-authorized-round carries a non-empty operator attestation (appended to sN-round-authorizations.jsonl, written before the call, added to WORK_DIFF_SET_BOOKKEEPING).
Varied the discovery fan-out framing: per-call spec-conformance / failure-scenario lenses, per-call prompts and per-call evidence stamps, discoveryLens recorded in the merged envelope.

Wired the severity-gated stop into the exit path: a Minor-only round is named, counted, told not to re-round, and offered only the close_session command; a clean round says VERIFIED -- no findings. At-bound blocking rounds no longer print a re-run command the CLI would refuse.
Added 22 tests across TestEnforcedBounds / TestDiscoveryLenses / TestMinorOnlyStop; updated the two pre-existing tests whose scenarios the new behavior changes.

Verification was transport-blocked: cli_transport.py hardcoded a 300s total dispatch ceiling with no config/env path, and a full session-verification bundle (~116KB over the Set 104 file handoff) could not complete inside it (two total-timeout dispatches, nothing written; a trivial prompt returned in 13s). Stopped to the operator rather than self-authorizing; operator chose option A. Added transports.copilot-cli.timeouts (spawn/first_byte/total), default-preserving, validated at load (unknown keys, non-numeric, non-positive, bool, and the spawn<first_byte<total ordering all refused), wired through __init__.py, set total_seconds: 1200, plus 6 tests.

Discovery round 2 (both lenses) + supplementary round 3. Both discovery lenses independently reported the undisclosed operator-authorized transport scope extension (Major); supplementary reported, with a reproduction, that a clean supplementary round consumes a discovery pass but writes no envelope, so a third pass was accepted unauthorized (Major).

Remediation round 1. L1/L2: disclosed the operator-authorized scope extension in s1-conventions.md with the decision trail and trade-off; CHANGELOG now carries the fourth (Set 111 S1) entry. L3: replaced the authorization-only file with ONE append-only round ledger sN-rounds.jsonl carrying both the pre-call operator-authorization and the post-call round-completed record (phase/verdict/blocking/endedLoop); count_phase_family_rounds now unions ledger records (endedLoop false) with envelopes by round number, so pre-ledger sessions keep enforcement and no round double-counts; tolerant reader survives a torn line; WORK_DIFF_SET_BOOKKEEPING renamed to s*-rounds.jsonl. Baseline discrimination proven: the reproduction test fails pre-fix (EXIT_BLOCKING, third pass routed) and passes fixed.

Remediation-review round 4 on the fix delta: VERIFIED, 0 blocking, fix verdicts 1 accepted + 1 accepted-with-modification + 1 duplicate-of. One nit (a stale sN-round-authorizations.jsonl echo in s1-conventions.md) fixed in the same pass per L-065-1; the earlier activity-log entry describing the superseded design is left as the historical record it is.

Registered session 2 via start_session (copilot / claude-opus-5 / high, provider anthropic). Read the preload (constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, AGENTS.md), the spec, and proposal SS5/SS6/SS9. Recorded the operator notes (2026-08-07) in operator-notes.md: unaccounted verification work is treated as third-party, and two Work Explorer context-menu convenience items are logged as future-set candidates.

Extended the verifier envelope with the acceptance block: verification.md gains per-Issue Acceptance criterion / Acceptance expectation lines plus a Writing an acceptance criterion section (template pin bumped to session-verification-v4 with its new pinned hash); verification._parse_acceptance parses executable (backticked command + exit/output expectation) vs judgment forms tolerantly; docs/session-issues.schema.json + session-issues-schema.md document the optional per-issue acceptance object.

Built ai_router/acceptance_harness.py: runs each UNCHANGED criterion against the round discoveryBaselineTree (pre-fix) and a fresh working-tree snapshot (fixed). Auto-closes ONLY on fails-before AND passes-after. Vacuous (passes pre-fix), still-failing, test-asset-modified, criterion-changed (contract hash covers command + expectations), refused-unsafe (shell operators), judgment, no-criterion and error all stay judgment-based. Results written to sN-acceptance-round-<M>.json.

Containment: both runs happen in disposable git worktrees checked out from captured tree objects via commit-tree, never the live working tree; no shell (metacharacters refused, not interpreted); credential-stripped environment with DABBLER_NO_ROUTER=1; wall-clock timeout; cleanup on every path including errors.

Retained exactly one remediation-review: verify_session.assemble_acceptance_block renders criteria-closed findings with both runs evidence and non-closing criteria with their reason, keyed by ledger ids from the new single-source blocking_ledger_id_map; the phase framing now directs attention to what the fixes BROKE and what the criteria MISSED. Fix-verdict coverage is unchanged (Set 096 S2 round-11 operator decision).

OPERATOR-AUTHORIZED SCOPE EXTENSION (2026-08-07): absence of provider API keys must never warn unless a direct-API dispatch is attempted. load_config gains require_api_keys (default False) and the validation moved to the named config.validate_provider_api_keys; ai_router.__init__._init() (the dispatch entry) passes require_api_keys=True; copilot-cli stays exempt inside the validator; providers.call_model still raises at the true point of use. Root-fixed the two drift-guard tests Session 1 had recorded as pre-existing environmental failures. Docs (quick-start, constitution Step 0, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md) now present Direct APIs and Copilot CLI side by side. Also recorded a Set 112 note to relabel the two transports in user-facing surfaces (new labels, same config values).

Root-fixed the second environmental class Session 1 had excused: 14 tests in test_pull_verifier (6), test_routing_exclusion_integrity (6) and test_orchestrator_identity (2) fake the DIRECT-API seam but loaded the seat config, so on this copilot-cli seat route() sailed past the fakes into the real CLI and hung up to 20 min each (S1 raised the ceiling to 1200s). Two shared conftest fixtures -- placeholder_provider_keys and direct_api_transport (a copy of the SHIPPED api-pinned router-config.yaml in a scratch dir with no local-overrides beside it) -- make them seat-independent. 115 passed in 17s and 148 passed/3 skipped in 18s.
Full run of record after the last code change, NOTHING deselected: 3,563 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped in 15m36s. First fully clean full run on this machine in the set.

Routed cross-provider verification, anthropic excluded, verifier gpt-5.5. Discovery round 1 (K=2, lenses spec-conformance + failure-scenario): ISSUES_FOUND, 5 blocking. Supplementary round 2: ISSUES_FOUND, 3 blocking. 8 findings, 6 distinct defects (2 cross-lens duplicate pairs). Both discovery passes now spent.

REMEDIATION ROUND 1 INCOMPLETE -- operator ended the working window. Fixed: broad test-runner/directory scope invalidation (is_test_runner, criterion_scopes, changed_paths_between, modified_test_assets_in_scope); .venv/bare-python interpreter rewrite (resolve_interpreter); shell/fetch program denylist. Built but NOT wired: raw_artifact_criteria + _call_key + OUTCOME_CRITERION_UNBOUND for the first-run-edit hole. NOT started: per-criterion worktree isolation, output evidence in the review block, correcting the over-claimed no-network/no-credentials wording (needs template v5). Full handoff in s2-remediation-round-1.md. Harness suite 61 passed.
